Compare opportunities against current position, expected value, required capability, trade-offs, and assumptions.
Define the opportunity clearly enough to compare it with alternatives.
Identify the people, resources, knowledge, systems, and funding required to pursue it.
Compare expected value, financial implications, capability needs, timing, and execution burden before selecting a route.
